signal: Scrut Automation raised $10M from Lightspeed, MassMutual Ventures and Endiya to add generative-AI use cases and expand its GRC platform into North America and Europe

email.subject1: a signal play for Scrut's ecosystem
email.body1:
Nicholas, saw Scrut raise the $10M from Lightspeed and others to add generative AI and expand into North America and Europe.

Expanding into new regions usually means more co-sell and partner targets than the team can cover at scale, and partner-sourced pipeline goes cold before anyone reaches it. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Scrut's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Nicholas, quick follow-up for Scrut partnerships.

New markets stretch co-sell thin: more partners and joint targets than the team can work, and partner-sourced pipeline coverage slips. The fix is covering the ecosystem without hiring against every new region.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a co-sell pilot playbook and a pipeline gap analysis showing exactly how many partner-sourced meetings Scrut needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add headcount.
email.body3:
Nicholas, last bit of proof for Scrut.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Scrut's reply rate likely compares to other GRC and security teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Nicholas, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and standing up co-sell across new regions keeps a partnerships leader busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your partner ecosystem? I'll tailor it to Scrut either way.
